title: DEMOCRAFT
description: The first minigame server accesible to everyone. Say welcome to the first real crossplay infrastructure. Take that Tubbo!
body:
DEMOCRAFT is a crossplay Minecraft minigames server online **since 2022**, playable on both Java and Bedrock editions 🌐 !
**Everyone plays together**, _no matter the platform :)_.

The server features pvp and non pvp minigames, like 🛏️ **Bedwars** , 🔫 **Quake** ,⚔️ **FFA** and 💥 **Skywars**, designed to be smooth, fair and fun for all players.
A **custom resource pack** is used across the server to enhance the experience 🎨 With multiples versions made for consoles/mobile devices, everybody can have an amazing experience playing with their friends !
